module FPGrowth
  class Node
    attr_reader :item, :parent, :children
    attr_accessor :count

    def initialize(item, parent)
      @item = item
      @parent = parent
      @children = {}
      @count = 0
    end
  end

  class Tree
    attr_reader :header, :nodes, :node_count

    def initialize(base, threshold)
      support = Hash.new(0)
      base.each { |items, weight| items.each { |item| support[item] += weight } }
      @header = support.keys.select { |item| support[item] >= threshold }.sort_by { |item| [-support[item], item] }
      position = @header.each_with_index.to_h
      @nodes = @header.to_h { |item| [item, []] }
      @node_count = 0
      root = Node.new(nil, nil)
      base.each do |items, weight|
        current = root
        items.select { |item| position.key?(item) }.sort_by { |item| position[item] }.each do |item|
          unless current.children.key?(item)
            node = Node.new(item, current)
            current.children[item] = node
            @nodes[item] << node
            @node_count += 1
          end
          current = current.children[item]
          current.count += weight
        end
      end
    end

    def conditional_base(item)
      @nodes.fetch(item).map do |node|
        path = []
        parent = node.parent
        until parent.item.nil?
          path << parent.item
          parent = parent.parent
        end
        [path.reverse, node.count]
      end
    end
  end

  def self.mine(baskets, threshold, maximum)
    whole = Tree.new(baskets.map { |basket| [basket.to_a, 1] }, threshold)
    statistics = { header: whole.header.length, nodes: whole.node_count, conditional_trees: 0, conditional_nodes: 0 }
    result = {}
    stack = [[whole, []]]
    until stack.empty?
      tree, suffix = stack.pop
      tree.header.reverse_each do |item|
        pattern = (suffix + [item]).sort
        result[pattern] = tree.nodes.fetch(item).sum(&:count)
        next if pattern.length == maximum

        conditional = Tree.new(tree.conditional_base(item), threshold)
        next if conditional.node_count.zero?

        statistics[:conditional_trees] += 1
        statistics[:conditional_nodes] += conditional.node_count
        stack << [conditional, pattern]
      end
    end
    statistics[:itemsets] = result.length
    [result, statistics]
  end
end

module Report
  RULE_HEADER = 'rank,antecedent,consequent,count,support,confidence,lift,leverage,conviction,improvement'

  def fraction(value)
    numerator = value.numerator
    denominator = value.denominator
    scaled = numerator.abs * 10_000 / denominator
    decimal = "#{scaled / 10_000}.#{(scaled % 10_000).to_s.rjust(4, '0')}"
    decimal = '-' + decimal if numerator.negative? && scaled.positive?
    "#{numerator}/#{denominator}=#{decimal}"
  end

  def percentage(numerator, denominator)
    scaled = 10_000 * numerator / denominator
    "#{scaled / 100}.#{(scaled % 100).to_s.rjust(2, '0')}%"
  end

  def money(cents)
    "#{cents / 100}.#{(cents % 100).to_s.rjust(2, '0')}"
  end

  def itemset(items)
    items.join('+')
  end

  def rule_csv(rule)
    values = [rule.rank, itemset(rule.antecedent), itemset(rule.consequent), rule.count]
    values.concat([rule.support, rule.confidence, rule.lift, rule.leverage].map { |value| fraction(value) })
    values << (rule.conviction.nil? ? 'INF' : fraction(rule.conviction))
    values << fraction(rule.improvement)
    values.join(',')
  end

  def write_files(files)
    Dir.mkdir('output') unless Dir.exist?('output')
    files.each do |name, lines|
      File.binwrite("output/#{name}", lines.join("\n") + (lines.empty? ? '' : "\n"))
    end
  end
end

module Rules
  Rule = Struct.new(:antecedent, :consequent, :count, :support, :confidence, :lift,
                    :leverage, :conviction, :improvement, :rank, keyword_init: true)

  def self.build(antecedent, consequent, n_x, n_y, n_z, total)
    Rule.new(antecedent: antecedent, consequent: consequent, count: n_z,
             support: Rational(n_z, total), confidence: Rational(n_z, n_x),
             lift: Rational(total * n_z, n_x * n_y),
             leverage: Rational(total * n_z - n_x * n_y, total * total),
             conviction: n_x == n_z ? nil : Rational((total - n_y) * n_x, total * (n_x - n_z)))
  end

  def self.passes?(rule, confidence, lift)
    rule.confidence >= confidence && rule.lift >= lift
  end

  def self.compare(left, right)
    order = right.confidence <=> left.confidence
    return order unless order.zero?

    order = right.lift <=> left.lift
    return order unless order.zero?

    order = right.count <=> left.count
    return order unless order.zero?

    order = left.antecedent <=> right.antecedent
    order.zero? ? left.consequent <=> right.consequent : order
  end
end
